# Ormonde Construction Ltd: its public claims,
and the evidence behind them.

This page lists the checkable claims ormondeconstruction.ie makes on its own public pages,
where each claim is made, and what the company itself has published that backs it. It was checked on 2026-10-27
by OneDroid, a third party, from the company's own public sources only: 75 claims, 5 evidenced,
3 contradicted, 67 with no evidence published.
Nothing on this page says a claim is true or false. Every reference points into a source whose sha256 as fetched is
listed at the end of the page, so anyone can fetch the same bytes and compare. The same page as Markdown:
/evidence/ormondeconstruction.ie.md.

## How to read this page

Verdict | Meaning | Count |

EVIDENCED | an artefact on the company's own surfaces would be false if the claim were | 5 |

CONTRADICTED | the company's own surfaces disagree with the claim; both sides are referenced | 3 |

NO EVIDENCE PUBLISHED | the claim is stated; nothing beyond the statement backs it in the sources checked | 67 |

These are the only three verdicts. They are statements about the company's own published sources as fetched on
2026-10-27, not about the world. A claim with no evidence published may well be true; the page says only that
the company has not shown it. A contradicted claim may have a reading that reconciles the two sources; where the
reviewers saw one, the note says so. Each claim has an id (C-001, C-002, ...) that is also its anchor on this page.
The method and the rules for every page are on the evidence pages index.

### Limits

Same sources only: the reviewers read what the company published and nothing else. They did not test the product,
interview anyone or use outside records. Every verdict is about the sources as fetched on 2026-10-27; a page can
change after that. One run is a sample of a moving site: a claim not listed may be right or wrong. The reviewers are
AI agents run by OneDroid, checked by hand on a sample; OneDroid is not independent of its own method.

### Right of reply

If you are Ormonde Construction Ltd and a line is wrong, write to michal@onedroid.ai
naming the claim id. Your answer is shown beside the verdict, in full and unedited, with its date, and does not replace
the verdict. If you publish new evidence, the claim is checked again from the new sources, with a new date and new
fingerprints, and the verdict changes when the evidence supports it. A wrong quote, URL or fingerprint is corrected
on request and listed in the change log.
